issue.title: Ledger balances are off by one cent after the midnight rollover
issue.body: Every account that carries a fractional cent forward shows a balance one cent lower than the statement once the nightly rollover runs. Reproduced on three test accounts by posting a partial-cent transaction just before midnight and diffing the ledger against the statement the next morning.
